top_signals.title: Tehran is a Different Beast Now
top_signals.summary:
The Tehran that the world knew is gone. It died in the fires with former Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei on the first day of the war in February. His son and new Supreme Leader, Mojtaba Khamenei — wherever he is and in whatever physical condition — witnessed his father, wife, and other close family members die in the same airstrike that wounded him. The White House believed that the conflict would last only a few weeks, but the Islamic Republic has proven less fragile than anticipated by the United States and Israel, who now must deal with surviving Iranian leaders

top_signals.title: Chevron Ends Support for Guyana Port Studies After Hess Acquisition
top_signals.summary: Chevron Corp. declined to continue supporting a proposed deep water port in Guyana after last year’s acquisition of Hess Corp., which had funded preliminary studies for the project.

top_signals.title: Argentina Economy Posts Sluggish Rebound After Sharp Drop
top_signals.summary: Argentina’s economy recovered mildly in August after a much sharper drop in July as growth continues to sputter in the second half of the year.

top_signals.title: NFL Taps General Atlantic To Expand Investing Venture
top_signals.summary:
The National Football League picked General Atlantic to set up an investing platform for a deeper push into global sports investing. Bloomberg's Scarlet Fu reports on "Bloomberg Deals."
 (Source: Bloomberg)
